nodes.question: What methodology is mentioned in the paper for analyzing the case study?
nodes.answer: Protocol analysis and guided expert interviews.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Drinking water standards and regulations|Quality assurance protocols_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How was the sediment sample prepared before being sent for further analysis to BEMLAB?
nodes.answer: A sediment subsample of 0.5 kg was separated from the homogenized dried sediment samples and sent to BEMLAB for further analysis.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Drinking water standards and regulations|Quality assurance protocols_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What method was used to determine the protein concentration in the samples?
nodes.answer: The Bradford method (1976) was used to determine the protein concentration in the samples using a Bio-Rad protein assay kit with bovine gamma globulin as a standard.
